Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Night forest road in a white car. Goal: stay on the road and progress. Controls: W throttle, A left, D right, S brake/reverse. Forward shows 1st; reverse shows R. Timer continues while stopped and during blacks. Blacks last many seconds; inputs during them are unhelpful. No-input waits of about 9–12 seconds can restore a centered 0 mph view in 1st with seven white fuel dots and red +5s. Real progress remains uncertain; the road may repeat or reset.

Observed road is mostly a repeating left curve with puddles and trees. STOPP signs appear on left grass. Some views also show STOPP and Petrol signs, tents, and a fire pit on right grass. +5s is visible on pavement and disappears off it. Fuel-dot, +5s, and red-X meanings, and whether black means crash, reset, or darkness, are unconfirmed.

From centered resets, short 0.1–0.2s W+A inputs follow the curve at low speed. Repeated left steering or coasting near 8–10 mph drifts onto left grass and removes +5s. Off left grass, one short W+D can turn toward pavement, but the car may instead face a tree; repeated W+D eventually causes black. Forward into trees can stall at 0 mph.

Reverse can free a stall: S+D changes 1st to R, often only after a second input, then short S+D inputs increase reverse speed. Recovery toward the road worked at low reverse speed, but reverse near 9–11 mph produced a red X and often preceded black. Coasting reduces reverse speed slowly while carrying the car sideways. S+A at 6 mph reverse on right grass caused immediate black.

Holding S while already reversing did not reliably brake. It raised speed from 6 to 14, then roughly 26, 28, and 29 mph, turned all seven fuel dots red, produced smoke, and ended in black. After waiting, the car reset centered at 0 mph in 1st with white fuel dots and +5s.

Latest cycle: three 0.1s W+A inputs reached 10 mph centered with +5s; one second of coasting fell to 8 mph but left the road; one 0.2s W+D reached 9 mph facing a tree. A 0.2s S+D input was issued, but its result is not yet observed. Continue cautiously, avoid accumulated left steering near 8–10 mph, and do not build high reverse speed.
